Type: bamboo-top rectangular dining table
Use: dining, working at a table; dining room, kitchen, home office
Style: Scandinavian, contemporary, minimalist
Materials: bamboo veneer top with rounded corners, white powder-coated tubular steel frame
Colors: warm honey bamboo, white
Shape: thin rectangular top on two looped steel trestle legs with diagonal braces, light and open, medium size
Feel: fresh, warm, airy, casual
Goes with: white or light wood chairs, green plants, white walls; Scandinavian kitchens and bright dining rooms
